name: playground
description: Agent 팀이 아이디어에서 웹과 앱을 자동으로 기획·개발·검증하는 소프트웨어 제작 플랫폼

scripts.build:bloom-web: pnpm exec tsc -p bloom-web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build bloom-web --outDir ../dist-bloom --emptyOutDir
scripts.build:web: pnpm run build:playground-web && pnpm run build:bloom-web
scripts.test:bloom-runtime: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.tmp/bloom-policy-tests',{recursive:true,force:true})" && pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec tsc -p ../../bloom-runtime/tsconfig.policy-tests.json && node bloom-runtime/run-policy-tests.cjs
scripts.build:bloom-worker: pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec tsc -p ../../bloom-runtime/tsconfig.worker.json && node --check bloom-worker/run.js && node --check bloom-worker/local-codex-shim.js && pnpm run test:bloom-local-runtime
scripts.build:apps: pnpm --filter ./apps/life-tracker run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/dev-notes run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/dev-action-hub run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/dev-term-roulette run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/idea-mixer run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/study-planner run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/focus-room run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/todo run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/day-schedule run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/cornell-notes run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/coding-log run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/school-meal run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/commute-alarm run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/mock-invest run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/action-notifier run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/code-run-visualizer run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/voice-phishing run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/virtual-study-room run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/virtual-avatar run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/voice-studio run build
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:apps
scripts.verify: pnpm run build:all && pnpm run harness
